config.order: one run of the script, each task in its own process; the whole run repeats in rounds, and the order of the libraries rotates from set to set and from round to round; the figure is the median round

DNI.description: 225 DNI in canonical form (8 digits and a letter): 150 valid, plus 75 of them with a wrong control letter.

NIE.description: 150 NIE in canonical form (X, Y or Z, 7 digits and a letter): 100 valid, plus 50 of them with a wrong control letter.

CIF.description: 270 CIF in canonical form (organisation key, 7 digits and a control character), every organisation key: 180 valid, plus 90 of them with a wrong control character.

mixed.description: 1001 strings of every kind: 500 valid (DNI, K/L/M, NIE, old-form NIE and CIF), 100 of them again in lower case, 250 with a wrong control character, and 151 junk strings (wrong lengths, random characters, the empty string).

contenders.label: nif-dni-nie-cif-validation (this build)
notes: Default options: the input is normalized (NORM-1 to NORM-4) and CIF control characters follow CIF-3.

contenders.label: nif-dni-nie-cif-validation (previous major)
notes: The previous major version. It is published as CommonJS only, so a bundler cannot drop what an import doesn't use.

contenders.label: better-dni
notes: DNI and NIE only: no CIF. Its documentation says that it validates a DNI (NIE / NIF), and it doesn't normalize (spaces and separators are rejected).

contenders.label: dni-js
notes: DNI and NIE only: no CIF. It is published as CommonJS only.

contenders.label: stdnum
notes: A multi-country library (about 90 countries): its size is larger by design. `ES.nif` validates DNI, NIE, K/L/M and CIF.

contenders.label: validator.js isIdentityCard(x, "ES")
notes: Spanish DNI and NIE only: validator.js has no CIF check. The one call covers both, so the DNI and NIE rows use the same function. A multi-purpose library (emails, URLs, and more).

contenders.label: validator.js isTaxID(x, "es-ES")
notes: Its source (`src/lib/isTaxID.js`, which the README points to for the exact support) says persons only: DNI and NIE, no CIF. The one call covers both. Its size includes the tax ID rules of every country it supports.

contenders.label: @kreyo/nif-validator
notes: One function for every type, so every row uses `isValid`. K/L/M NIFs are only accepted with the option `includeDeprecated: true`; the benchmark uses the default, as its documentation does.

contenders.label: jsvat (Spain)
notes: A VAT number validator (deprecated on npm, repository archived): every input is prefixed with "ES" before it is validated, and the prefix is added outside the timed loop and outside the agreement check of the library. It does not accept a bare NIF.
